get.description:
Lists the contract compliance documents

**Procore Pay must be enabled to use this endpoint.**

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description:
Return only compliance documents in the given statuses. Repeat the parameter to filter on more than one status. Omit it to return documents in every status.

Example usage:

        ?status[]=not_compliant&status[]=in_review&status[]=revision_needed

Documents still stored under a legacy status are matched by the current equivalent — `not_compliant` also returns `not_submitted` documents, `in_review` also returns `review_pending`, `revision_needed` also returns `revise_and_resubmit`, and `compliant` also returns `approved`. The legacy values themselves are not accepted as filter values.

A value outside the enum returns `400 Bad Request`.

parameters.name: allow_vendor_submission
parameters.description: Return only compliance documents whose vendor submission setting matches the given value. Omit it to return documents regardless of the setting.

x-changelog.summary: Add list and show endpoints for contract compliance documents
x-changelog.description:
New endpoints to list and retrieve compliance documents associated with a contract.
`GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents` returns a paginated list of compliance documents for the specified contract.
`GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents/{id}` returns a single compliance document by ID.
Requires `view_compliance_information` permission on the commitments tool.

x-changelog.summary: Add status and allow_vendor_submission filters to the contract compliance documents list endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The list endpoint now accepts optional `status[]` and `allow_vendor_submission` query parameters, which can be used on their own or together.
`status[]` may be repeated to match several statuses, for example `?status[]=not_compliant&status[]=in_review&status[]=revision_needed`.
Documents still stored under a legacy status are matched by the current equivalent, so `compliant` also returns documents stored as `approved`.
A status outside the documented list returns a 400.
Omitting the parameters preserves the existing unfiltered behavior.

x-changelog.summary: Add required_for_vendor_submission field to the contract compliance documents list and show responses
x-changelog.description:
The `required_for_vendor_submission` field is now returned by:
`GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents` (list)
`GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents/{id}` (show)
When true, the vendor must submit this compliance document before they can submit an invoice. Only applicable when `allow_vendor_submission` is true. Defaults to false.
The field is returned only; it is not yet accepted in create or update requests.

x-changelog.summary: Add compliance_document_requirement_id to contract compliance document responses
x-changelog.description:
List, show, create, and update now return `compliance_document_requirement_id`.
It contains the parent document requirement ID for documents created from a template and is null for manually created documents.

x-changelog.summary: Add create, update, and delete endpoints for contract compliance documents
x-changelog.description:
New write endpoints for compliance documents associated with a contract.
`POST /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents` creates a compliance document for the specified contract. Requires admin permission on the commitments tool.
`PATCH /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents/{id}` updates a compliance document. Requires admin permission or bill-recipient status on the contract.
`DELETE /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents/{id}` deletes a compliance document. Requires admin permission on the commitments tool.

x-changelog.summary: Add send_expiration_notification parameter to create and update endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The `send_expiration_notification` boolean parameter is now accepted in the request body for:
`POST /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents` (create)
`PATCH /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents/{id}` (update)
When set to true, an expiration notification will be sent before the compliance document expires. Only commitment admins can set or update this field; non-admin users will receive a 400 error.

x-changelog.summary: Add required_for_vendor_submission parameter to create and update endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The `required_for_vendor_submission` boolean parameter is now accepted in the request body for:
`POST /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents` (create)
`PATCH /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/contracts/{contract_id}/documents/{id}` (update)
When true, the vendor must submit this compliance document before they can submit an invoice. It is only applicable when the effective `allow_vendor_submission` is true and is forced to false otherwise. Defaults to false on create.
Only commitment admins can change this value on an existing document; other users receive a 400 error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"name\":\"Document One\",\"document_type\":\"bond\",\"status\":\"approved\",\"reviewer_notes\":\"Reviewer Notes\",\"notes\":\"GC notes\",\"prostore_file_ids\":[\"123456\"],\"effective_at\":\"2021-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\"expires_at\":\"2021-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\"allow_vendor_submission\":true,\"required_for_vendor_submission\":false,\"send_expiration_notification\":true}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/compliance/contracts/%7Bcontract_id%7D/documents/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
